title: DNA: Differentially private Neural Augmentation for contact tracing
abstract: arXiv:2404.13381v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The COVID19 pandemic had enormous economic and societal consequences. Contact tracing is an effective way to reduce infection rates by detecting potential virus carriers early. However, this was not generally adopted in the recent pandemic, and privacy concerns are cited as the most important reason. We substantially improve the privacy guarantees of the current state of the art in decentralized contact tracing. Whereas previous work was based on statistical inference only, we augment the inference with a learned neural network and ensure that this neural augmentation satisfies differential privacy. In a simulator for COVID19, even at epsilon=1 per message, this can significantly improve the detection of potentially infected individuals and, as a result of targeted testing, reduce infection rates. This work marks an important first step in integrating deep learning into contact tracing while maintaining essential privacy guarantees.

translated_title: DNA：用于接触者追踪的差分隐私神经增强
translated_abstract: COVID-19疫情对经济和社会产生了巨大的影响。接触者追踪是一种通过早期发现潜在病毒携带者来降低感染率的有效方法。然而，在最近的疫情中，这种方法并未得到普遍采用，隐私担忧被认为是其中最重要的原因。我们大幅改进了当前最先进的去中心化接触者追踪方法的隐私保证。与以往仅基于统计推断的工作不同，我们使用学习到的神经网络来增强推断，并确保这种神经增强满足差分隐私。在COVID-19模拟器中，即使在每条消息epsilon=1的隐私预算下，该方法也能显著提高对潜在感染者的检测能力，并通过针对性检测降低感染率。这项工作标志着在保持必要隐私保证的同时，将深度学习集成到接触者追踪中的重要第一步。
tldr: 该论文提出DNA方法，通过满足差分隐私的神经网络增强去中心化接触者追踪的统计推断，在严格隐私保证（epsilon=1）下显著提高潜在感染者的检测率并降低感染率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DNA, which augments statistical inference in decentralized contact tracing with a differentially private neural network, significantly improving detection of potentially infected individuals while maintaining strong privacy guarantees (epsilon=1).
